label: Diagram 11.1
caption: Diagram 11.1 | Principles of space separation side B1 B2
description: This is a three-part perspective diagram, Diagram 11.1 "Principles of space separation", with "See para 11.4" at the top left. A dashed line, identified in the bottom-left legend as the "Relevant boundary", runs diagonally across the lower part of the drawing. Three vertical wall slabs are arranged left to right, each with a short line meeting that dashed boundary. The left slab carries a small four-paned window high up; its caption reads "Wall on or very close to the relevant boundary: very limited amounts of unprotected area", and a pointer to the slab is labelled "Fire resisting from both sides". The middle slab has a larger rectangular opening; its caption reads "Wall not on, or not very close to, but not sufficiently far from relevant boundary that it can be a wholly unprotected area", and the pointer is labelled "Fire resisting from inside: reduced insulation criterion". The right slab shows three panelled doors; its caption reads "Wall sufficiently distant from relevant boundary to be a 100% unprotected area", and the pointer is labelled "No provision for fire resistance". Green double-headed arrows run from the dashed line to the middle and right slabs, corresponding to the legend entry "Amount of unprotected area dependent on distance from relevant boundary".

notes: The description says "Green double-headed arrows run from the dashed line to the middle and right slabs", but the drawing shows two single-headed green arrows with arrowheads only at the slab ends; the only double-headed green arrow is the small one next to the legend text "Amount of unprotected area dependent on distance from relevant boundary".
